name: M-Files
description_en: M-Files is a metadata-driven document-management platform that connects documents to objects such as projects, customers and workflows. It offers Cloud and self-hosted deployment and distinct Essentials/Enterprise packaging. Its classic Desktop/Admin guide describes check-in, version rollback and permissions whose effective result depends on several active sources. Aino and external collaboration have separate configuration, capacity and licensing conditions.
description_zh: M-Files 是元数据驱动文档管理平台，将文档与项目、客户及流程等对象关联，提供云和自行部署，以及不同 Essentials／Enterprise 方案。经典 Desktop／Admin 指南描述签入、版本回退和权限，有效结果取决于多个生效来源。Aino 与外部协作另有配置、容量和许可条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Automatic restrictions activate through relevant metadata values and combine with object rights.
core_features.explanation_zh: 自动限制由相关元数据值激活，并与对象权限共同生效。

core_features.explanation_en: Rollback creates a new content/metadata version; restored workflow state can cause actions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 回退创建内容元数据新版本，恢复的流程状态可能触发动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Monthly content processing is shared across the subscription and may pause at exhaustion.
core_features.explanation_zh: 月度内容处理额度由订阅共享，用尽可能暂停。

sections.title_en: Define the business object and the client in use
sections.title_zh: 定义业务对象与所用客户端
sections.en:
M-Files presents document management through metadata and relationships to the work the document supports. A vault view is not simply a second independent copy of a filesystem folder. The current sales page distinguishes Cloud/self-hosted packaging, while the detailed operational guide reviewed here explicitly covers Classic M-Files Desktop and M-Files Admin. Do not promise identical controls or installed helpers in every new Web or Microsoft365 experience.

An editorial pilot could use a fictional project contract with a project reference, counterparty, contract class, owner and lifecycle state. Define which object is the authoritative contract and which linked documents support it. Specify what an ordinary project member should read and what an approver may change. Confirm the deployment, client and edition before configuring that model. This is a proposed synthetic exercise, not an installed vault, contract approval or measured retrieval result.
sections.zh:
M-Files 通过元数据及其与业务工作的关系呈现文档管理，库视图不是文件系统文件夹的第二份独立副本。当前销售页区分云和自行部署，本文实读操作指南则明确覆盖 Classic M-Files Desktop 及 M-Files Admin，不能承诺每种新 Web 或 Microsoft365 体验有相同控件和助手。

建议试点可用虚构项目合同，设置项目编号、对方主体、合同类别、所有者和生命周期状态，明确哪个对象是权威合同、哪些关联文档辅助它，并定义普通成员可读和审批者可改范围。建模前需确认部署、客户端和版本。这是建议模拟练习，不是已安装库、合同审批或检索实测。

sections.title_en: Check-in and workflow decisions need separate evidence
sections.title_zh: 签入与流程决定需分别核对
sections.en:
Classic checkout prevents concurrent editing while others may read. Desktop and Web use different caches, so the same person can appear as another checkout holder across clients. Undo Checkout discards unsent changes; if the object has never been checked in, it deletes that object. Do not treat undo as a way to retrieve local edits. Check-in makes changes available, and check-in comments retain the permissions they had when created.

Workflow states are configured in Admin and changed through the documented state controls, with signatures when configured. For the proposed contract, distinguish the uploaded version from the approval decision and check the resulting state. The guide’s Cancel entry in the state-comment dialog describes omitting the comment while making the transition; it must not be interpreted as a safe universal rollback control. No editor, comment, signature or state transition was operated.
sections.zh:
经典签出防止并发编辑，他人仍可读取。Desktop 与 Web 使用不同缓存，同一人在不同客户端可能被显示为另一签出者。Undo Checkout 丢弃未发送修改，若对象从未签入，还会删除该对象，不能作为找回本地编辑的方法。签入使变更可用，签入评论保留创建时权限。

流程状态在 Admin 配置，按文档控件改变，并可按配置要求签名。建议合同应区分上传版本和审批决定，并核对最终状态。指南中的状态评论对话框 Cancel 项描述为省略评论但仍执行转移，不能当作通用安全回退控件。本研究未操作编辑、评论、签名或状态转移。

sections.title_en: A broad object grant can still be restricted by metadata
sections.title_zh: 对象宽泛授权仍会受元数据限制
sections.en:
When extended automatic permissions apply, each requested right must be allowed by every active permission source. An object-level full-control grant does not override a restrictive project/class-derived source. Metadata values activate automatic rights; merely enabling the property rule does not apply it to an object without the relevant value. Indirect chains of inherited automatic permissions are not followed.

For the contract, inspect the source list and effective rights after adding its project and class. Read, edit, delete and changing permissions are different rights; explicit denial takes precedence, and a user allowed to change permissions can grant additional rights to themselves. Test the ordinary project identity rather than an administrator. The guide also records an external-repository promotion limitation and an engine-specific multi-ACL search restriction, so a missing search result need not mean the contract was deleted. No rights or metadata changed, and the installed enforcement paths were not tested.
sections.zh:
启用扩展自动权限时，每项请求权利都需所有生效来源同时允许，对象本身完全控制不覆盖来自项目或类别的限制。元数据值会激活自动权限，只开启属性规则而未为对象添加相关值不会生效，间接继承的自动权限链也不会继续传递。

建议合同添加项目和类别后，应检查来源列表及有效权限。读取、编辑、删除及更改权限不同，明确拒绝优先，获准更改权限者还可给自己授予其他权利。需使用普通项目身份而非管理员测试。指南另记载外部库提升限制及特定搜索引擎的多 ACL 来源限制，因此搜不到不一定表示合同已删除。本研究未改权限或元数据，也未测试实际执行路径。

sections.title_en: Rollback can restore a workflow state as well as content
sections.title_zh: 回退可能同时恢复流程状态和内容
sections.en:
Classic history holds earlier object versions whose content and metadata cannot be edited in place. Viewing a prior version requires access both to that version and to the latest checked-in version. A history label such as Approved is a label, and should be checked against the actual lifecycle and decision evidence.

Rollback creates a new object version from old content and metadata and preserves intermediate versions. It requires the object not to be checked out and appropriate edit/change-permission rights. The guide warns that restoring a version with a workflow state can cause unwanted actions. For the synthetic contract, identify which old state and relationships will return and which notifications or automation could run before considering rollback. This is not the same as recovering a deleted vault, server backup or tenant. Exact deletion restoration, export completeness and disaster recovery were not established; no rollback, purge, backup or restore was performed.
sections.zh:
经典历史保留旧对象版本，其内容元数据不能原地修改。查看旧版同时需要该版本及最新已签入版的访问权限。Approved 等历史标签本质是标签，应与真实生命周期和决定证据核对。

回退用旧内容元数据创建新对象版本并保留中间版，要求对象未签出且具有适用编辑更改权限。指南警告恢复带流程状态的版本可能触发不需要的动作。模拟合同考虑回退前应确定恢复哪些旧状态关系、可能运行哪些通知自动化。这不同于恢复已删除库、服务器备份或租户。准确删除恢复、完整导出及灾难恢复未确立，本研究未回退、永久删除、备份或恢复。

sections.title_en: Aino answers depend on content, scope and shared capacity
sections.title_zh: Aino 回答依赖内容、范围和共享容量
sections.en:
The reviewed Aino guide distinguishes ordinary text processing from an administrator-enabled Multimodal capability for visual content. It warns of incomplete or incorrect answers and difficulty with roughly100-page-or-larger documents. Answer sources respect vault rights. Excluding content from vault-wide answering does not prevent a user selecting that single document and asking about it; multi-document/vault queries also require a separately configured, additional-cost capability.

Monthly processing capacity is shared across subscription users; a90% warning precedes exhaustion, when Aino becomes temporarily unavailable. Prior chat answers can also be affected by changed source documents. For the proposed contract, ask one defined question, inspect the cited clause and version, and review any saved metadata rather than treating an answer as approval or a compliance finding. Exact current quota, model/provider retention and deployment-specific data route remain unknown. No question, prompt, chat, feedback or metadata save was submitted.
sections.zh:
已读 Aino 指南区分普通文字处理与管理员启用的多模态视觉能力，并提醒回答可能错误或不完整，约一百页及以上大文档处理困难。回答按库权限取来源；排除库级问答内容不阻止用户选择单篇再询问，多篇或库级查询也需要另配置并付额外费用。

月处理容量由订阅用户共享，达到90%提醒，用尽后暂不可用；源文档改变还可能影响旧对话答案。建议合同可提出一个明确问题，再核对引用条款及版本，审阅保存的元数据，不能将回答当审批或合规结论。当前准确额度、模型提供方保留及部署数据路径未知。本研究未提交问题、提示、对话、反馈或元数据保存。

sections.title_en: Price the selected deployment and capacity
sections.title_zh: 按所选部署和容量报价
sections.en:
The current page displays Essentials at EUR65 per seat per month and quotes Enterprise by scale, governance, automation, external usage and AI/content volume. Its FAQ says subscriptions are typically billed annually, so a displayed monthly rate is not proof of cancellable month-to-month billing. Ten seats would imply EUR650 per displayed month before unverified contractual minimums, services and tax; this is arithmetic, not an accepted quote.

The page describes additional storage, implementation/managed services and Premium Cloud separately. Its Hubshare wording combines inclusion in Enterprise with separate licensing based on collaboration scale, so an external guest population must be costed explicitly. Cloud/self-hosted packaging can differ. Current price, entitlement, storage location and Aino allowance must be confirmed for the actual deployment rather than borrowed from another edition. No current sustained-free or trial entitlement was established, and no contact, quote, agreement or purchase was made.
sections.zh:
当前页显示 Essentials 每席每月 EUR65，Enterprise 按规模、治理、自动化、外部用量及 AI 内容量报价。FAQ 说明通常按年计费，因此显示月率不证明可按月随时取消。十席按显示月率为 EUR650，尚未计入未核实合同最低量、服务及税；这是算术而非已接受报价。

页面另列附加存储、实施托管服务及 Premium Cloud。Hubshare 表述同时包含 Enterprise 纳入和按协作规模独立许可，因此外部访客需明确计价。云及自行部署包装也可能不同，应确认目标部署价格、权益、存储地区和 Aino 额度，不借用其他版本条件。未确立当前持续免费或试用权益，本研究未联系、询价、接受协议或购买。

sections.title_en: Use the service agreement for data and exit responsibilities
sections.title_zh: 通过服务协议明确数据和退出责任
sections.en:
The privacy page separates customer/marketing notices, suppliers and service-specific DPAs. The linked2024service DPA describes the customer as controller and M-Files as processor under the applicable agreements. It says personal data should not be sent in a support request without prior notification, and that processor help and subprocessors follow agreement-specific conditions. A generic privacy page is not proof that all contract files or AI processing stay in one country.

After expiry or termination, the DPA provides for a hosted-data copy and deletion, subject to the agreement, law and continuity/disaster-recovery exceptions. It does not establish a tested export format, a universal grace period or restoration of all workflow/history information. Full software/service licensing, renewal and cancellation terms were not obtained; paid packaging and third-party connectors do not themselves settle open-source status. Keep the license flag unknown and obtain the applicable order before relying on those terms. No support material, personal data, export or cancellation request was sent.
sections.zh:
隐私页区分客户营销通知、供应商及服务专属 DPA。所链接的2024年服务 DPA 按适用协议将客户列为控制方、M-Files 为处理方，并要求支持请求发送个人资料前先通知；处理方协助及分处理方均依协议条件。通用隐私页不证明所有合同文件和 AI 处理留在单一国家。

DPA 规定到期或终止后提供托管数据副本并删除，但受协议、法律及连续性灾难恢复例外限定，不确立实测导出格式、统一宽限期或完整流程历史恢复。完整软件服务许可、续费及取消条款尚未取得；付费包装和第三方连接器本身也不决定开源状态，许可标记保留未知，使用前需确认订单。本研究未发送支持资料、个人数据、导出或取消请求。
